title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Detecting Satirical Code-Mixed Sentences
abstract: arXiv:2610.29907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code-switching is a natural linguistic phenomenon, yet its impact on high-level reasoning tasks remains largely unexplored in under-resourced languages like Romanian. Natural language processing tasks, such as satire detection, rely heavily on nuanced cultural and syntactic cues that large language models struggle to capture. In this paper, we investigate four methods (i.e., random replacement, phrase translation, dependency parsing, and large language models) for generating synthetic code-mixed Romanian sentences with English, German, French, and Italian. We start with an existing dataset for satire detection, compiled from Romanian news articles and annotated at the sentence level by humans, and augment it with over 600k samples, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. We provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset generation process. Then, we evaluate several multilingual large language models across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes o

translated_title: 面向讽刺性语码混合句子检测的大型语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 语码转换是一种自然的语言现象，然而其对高级推理任务的影响在罗马尼亚语等资源匮乏的语言中仍未得到充分探索。讽刺检测等自然语言处理任务高度依赖于细微的文化和句法线索，而大型语言模型难以捕捉这些线索。在本文中，我们研究了四种生成罗马尼亚语与英语、德语、法语和意大利语混合的合成语码混合句子的方法（即随机替换、短语翻译、依存句法分析和大型语言模型）。我们从一个现有的讽刺检测数据集出发——该数据集由罗马尼亚语新闻文章汇编而成，并由人工在句子级别进行标注——并用超过60万个样本对其进行扩充，构建了CS-SeLeRoSa数据集。我们对数据集的生成过程进行了深入分析。随后，我们在零样本、思维链和微调等多种设置下对多个多语言大型语言模型进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文构建了包含60余万样本的罗马尼亚语语码混合讽刺检测数据集CS-SeLeRoSa，并系统基准测试了多语言大模型在零样本、思维链和微调三种模式下检测讽刺性语码混合句子的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CS-SeLeRoSa, a 600k+ sample dataset of code-mixed Romanian sentences for satire detection, and benchmarks multilingual large language models under zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes.
